checklist.note: Re-walked after the material delta — a single invalid YAML escape repaired in the frontmatter description. No directive aimed at a reading agent anywhere in SKILL.md or references/.
No data sent off-box; the skill ships no script and makes no network call.
No key, token, or credential in SKILL.md, references/evidence.md, or the two JSON schemas.
No destructive shell the skill runs — it bundles no scripts/ directory at all.
Nothing unreadable on purpose; prose, a rubric, and two plain JSON schemas.
No external host reached and no download-and-run.
No credential-store read anywhere in the material.
No sudo, setuid, or persistence mechanism; the plugin registers no hooks.
